description: (Na)₂CrTlF₆ crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a CrTlF₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 16-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the CrTlF₆ framework, Cr is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form CrF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent TlF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Cr-F bond lengths are 1.93 Å. Tl is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form TlF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent CrF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Tl-F bond lengths are 2.57 Å. F is bonded in a linear geometry to one Cr and one Tl atom.
